 const isDeepStrictEqual = __vite_ssr_import_0__.default["isDeepStrictEqual"];

function referenceWindowRows(rows, direction, window) {
  return [...rows].sort((left, right) => {
    const rankOrder = Number.isNaN(left.rank) ? Number.isNaN(right.rank) ? 0 : 1 : Number.isNaN(right.rank) ? -1 : left.rank < right.rank ? -1 : left.rank > right.rank ? 1 : 0;
    return rankOrder * (direction === `asc` ? 1 : -1) || left.id - right.id;
  }).slice(window.offset, window.offset + window.limit).map(({ id, rank }) => ({ id, rank }));
};
function referenceJoinedWindowRows(facts, direction, window) {
  const marked = new Set(facts.marked);
  return referenceWindowRows(
    facts.roots.filter(({ id }) => !marked.has(id)),
    direction,
    window
  ).map(({ id, rank }) => ({
    id,
    rank,
    children: facts.children.filter((child) => child.parent === id).map((child) => child.id).sort((left, right) => left - right)
  }));
};
function checkRetainedWindowSnapshot(expected, actual, checkpoint) {
  if (!isDeepStrictEqual(actual.rows, expected.rows))
    throw new Error(
      `atomic window publication at ${checkpoint}: expected rows ${JSON.stringify(expected.rows)}, got ${JSON.stringify(actual.rows)}`
    );
  if (!isDeepStrictEqual(actual.window, expected.window))
    throw new Error(
      `atomic window publication at ${checkpoint}: expected settled window ${JSON.stringify(expected.window)}, got ${JSON.stringify(actual.window)}`
    );
};
